criteria: Content specific to the source project is removed and its region becomes a slot; a generic shape with a project-specific name is renamed. Slot names: leading, title, subtitle, trailing, actions, brand, illustration, footer. Hard-coded copy becomes a prop with a neutral default.

changes.change: Merge AgentCell, AgentTitle, BranchInline, ModelCell, SessionCell, SessionInline, TaskCell, ToolTitle and UserInline into one `Entity` with `layout` (`inline` | `cell` | `title`), the slots `leading`, `title`, `subtitle` and `trailing` (ToolTitle's badge goes in `trailing`), and a `kind` key into an `EntityKinds` map the implementor supplies through `EntityKindsProvider` (icon, tone and default texts per kind). The kit ships no kinds; stories use a neutral demo map. `SessionStatus` and `SESSION_STATUS_TONE` become `ActivityStatus` and `ACTIVITY_STATUS_TONE`, with the same five values.

Replace the five fixed kinds (`SearchSuggestionKind`, `KIND_ICON` and the kind pill variants) with a `kind` that reads the same `EntityKinds` map as `Entity`. The placeholder becomes a prop defaulting to "Search…".
The cell types `agent-title`, `agent-cell`, `session-inline`, `session-cell` and the other KnownEntities keys become `entity-inline`, `entity-cell` and `entity-title`, rendering `Entity`.

Rename `TokensConsumption` to `QuotaUsage`; `TokensProgress`, `TOKENS_WARN_RATIO` and `TOKENS_DANGER_RATIO` to `QuotaProgress`, `QUOTA_WARN_RATIO` and `QUOTA_DANGER_RATIO`; `SpendOverTime` to `AmountOverTime`, with its `cost` prop renamed `amount`. Their cva exports and prop types follow the same names. In `src/organisms/Table/cellTypes.tsx` the cell types `tokens-progress` and `spend-over-time` become `quota-progress` and `amount-over-time`.
The fixed "Create workspace" label becomes a `submitLabel` prop with a neutral default.
Rename the folder, the component, its variants and its types to `Monogram`.
Drop the source's mark (`TomatoMark`) and add an optional `illustration` slot in its place.
Remove `onSwitchWorkspace` and its "Switch workspace" item, and add an `actions` slot for extra menu items.
Replace `BrandLockup`, which draws the source's mark and name, with a `brand` slot.
Rename `SidebarWeekSummary` to `SidebarQuota`, drop its default `tokens` unit, and give its heading a `title` slot.

atRecombination: Delete `src/internal/TomatoMark.tsx` once no file imports it; stories that drew it fill the new slots with a neutral placeholder.
Remove the `--wordmark-tomato` tokens, their theme mapping and the `.wordmark` rule once no file uses them (Badge's variants and the shell fixtures did).

Rename the packages: `packages/ui/package.json` from `@ar/ui` to `@open-tomato/components`, the package that ships, and the private root `package.json` from `agentic-research` to `components-workspace`; run `bun install` so `bun.lock` follows, and update the name in `packages/ui/README.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. `NOTICE` keeps its mentions, because it credits the source.
